question.en: What is the primary function of the parking brake (handbrake) in a heavy motor vehicle?
question.af: [AF] What is the primary function of the parking brake (handbrake) in a heavy motor vehicle?
question.xh: [XH] What is the primary function of the parking brake (handbrake) in a heavy motor vehicle?
question.zu: [ZU] What is the primary function of the parking brake (handbrake) in a heavy motor vehicle?
question.st: [ST] What is the primary function of the parking brake (handbrake) in a heavy motor vehicle?

en.A: To slow down the vehicle while driving at high speed.
en.B: To keep the vehicle stationary once parked and prevent rolling.

af.A: [AF] To slow down the vehicle while driving at high speed.
af.B: [AF] To keep the vehicle stationary once parked and prevent rolling.

xh.A: [XH] To slow down the vehicle while driving at high speed.
xh.B: [XH] To keep the vehicle stationary once parked and prevent rolling.

zu.A: [ZU] To slow down the vehicle while driving at high speed.
zu.B: [ZU] To keep the vehicle stationary once parked and prevent rolling.

st.A: [ST] To slow down the vehicle while driving at high speed.
st.B: [ST] To keep the vehicle stationary once parked and prevent rolling.

explanation.en: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines.
explanation.af: [AF] The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines.
explanation.xh: [XH] The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines.
explanation.zu: [ZU] The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines.
explanation.st: [ST] The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines.

memory_tricks.en: K53 Golden Rule: Always check mirrors, signal early, and verify safe clearances before performing any manoeuvre.
memory_tricks.af: K53 Goue Reël: Kontroleer altyd jou spieëls, dui betyds aan en verifieer veilige afstande.
memory_tricks.xh: Umthetho wa K53: Jonga izipili zakho, unike uphawu kwakukhawuleza, uqinisekise indawo ekhuselekileyo.
memory_tricks.zu: Umthetho we-K53: Bheka izibuko zakho njalo, unike uphawu kusenesikhathi, uqinisekise amabanga aphephile.
memory_tricks.st: Molao wa K53: Lebella diipone tsa gago ka mehla, fana ka letshwao esale hantle, mme o netefatse sebaka se bolokehileng.

veteran_k53_examiner.en: Attention Candidate. Under the National Road Traffic Act: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. Non-compliance results in immediate test failure.

veteran_k53_examiner.st: Mametse Mokopi. Tlas'a Molao wa Tsela: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. Ho se mamele ho lebisa ho hloleheng hang-hang.

socratic_memory_guide.en: Let's think through this together 🤔 Why is this rule enforced? Remember: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. What would happen if a driver ignored this on a busy road?

socratic_memory_guide.xh: Masicinge ngale nto kunye 🤔 Kutheni lo mthetho usetyenziswa? Khumbula: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. Yintoni eya kwenzeka ukuba umqhubi akayinanzi le nto?
socratic_memory_guide.zu: Ake sicabange ngalokhu ndawonye 🤔 Kungani lo mthetho usetshenziswa? Khumbula: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. Yini engenzeka uma umshayeli ewushaya indiva lo mthetho?
socratic_memory_guide.st: A re nagane ka sena mmoho 🤔 Ke hobane'ng ha molao ona o kenngwa tshebetsong? Hopola: The parking brake is designed to hold a stationary vehicle securely in place when parked or stopping on inclines. Ho ne ho tla etsahala'ng ha mokganni a ka o hlokomologa?

memory_tricks.en: Shape & Colour Rule: Red Circles = PROHIBITION (NO!), Blue Circles = COMMAND (MUST!), Red Triangles = WARNING (WATCH OUT!).

memory_tricks.xh: Imilo neLanga: Isirkyuli eMbozi = UKUVALA, eLuhlaza = UMYALELO, iDriehoek eMbozi = ISILUMKISO.
memory_tricks.zu: Isimo Nombala: Indilinga Ebomvu = INQABO, Indilinga Esibhakabhaka = UMYALELO, Unxantathu = ISIXWAYISO.
memory_tricks.st: Setso le Mmala: Selikaliko se Sehibedu = TLELE, Selikaliko se Serohlano = TSHWANELO, Dithothokiso = DILEMO.

memory_tricks.en: Shape & Colour Rule: Red Circles = PROHIBITION (NO!), Blue Circles = COMMAND (MUST!), Red Triangles = WARNING (WATCH OUT!).
memory_tricks.af: Vorm & Kleur: Rooi Sirkels = VERBOD (NEE!), Blou Sirkels = OPDRAG (MOET!), Rooi Driehoeke = WAARSKUWING.
memory_tricks.xh: Imilo neLanga: Isirkyuli eMbozi = UKUVALA, eLuhlaza = UMYALELO, iDriehoek eMbozi = ISILUMKISO.
memory_tricks.zu: Isimo Nombala: Indilinga Ebomvu = INQABO, Indilinga Esibhakabhaka = UMYALELO, Unxantathu = ISIXWAYISO.
memory_tricks.st: Setso le Mmala: Selikaliko se Sehibedu = TLELE, Selikaliko se Serohlano = TSHWANELO, Dithothokiso = DILEMO.

memory_tricks.en: Shape & Colour Rule: Red Circles = PROHIBITION (NO!), Blue Circles = COMMAND (MUST!), Red Triangles = WARNING (WATCH OUT!).

memory_tricks.xh: Imilo neLanga: Isirkyuli eMbozi = UKUVALA, eLuhlaza = UMYALELO, iDriehoek eMbozi = ISILUMKISO.
memory_tricks.zu: Isimo Nombala: Indilinga Ebomvu = INQABO, Indilinga Esibhakabhaka = UMYALELO, Unxantathu = ISIXWAYISO.
memory_tricks.st: Setso le Mmala: Selikaliko se Sehibedu = TLELE, Selikaliko se Serohlano = TSHWANELO, Dithothokiso = DILEMO.
